name: generate_native_claude_skill
description: Verifies Skill Factory produces standard SKILL.md + scripts/ + references/ + assets/ layout
input_prompt: Create a new skill named 'security-audit' with role 'Principal Security Engineer'.
expected_behavior: Generates complete native directory structure with SKILL.md, validate_security_audit.py, guide, and manifest.

name: evaluate_compatibility_matrix
description: Verifies Skill Factory computes 2D host x model matrix and warns on degraded combinations
input_prompt: Evaluate compatibility matrix for 'ship' across Claude, Cursor, and Codex.
expected_behavior: Reports full compatibility on Claude Code and partial/degraded on Cursor/Codex with actionable fallbacks.

name: calculate_run_cost_metadata
description: Verifies accurate token and USD calculation for model execution
input_prompt: Compute run cost metadata for 10000 input tokens, 2000 output tokens on claude-3-7-sonnet.
expected_behavior: Computes exact estimated cost based on $3/M in and $15/M out.
